notes.title: Patch no.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

This patch includes fixes and improvements across a range of areas identified by players - thanks for all the feedback received so far! - Mike 

- added 'danger' signs at screen-edge to give warning of where vehicles will enter the screen 
- increased the pick-up range when walking over collectables eg ammo crate, cash, gems
- added ability to drop a held collected weapons/replace held weapon by picking up a new one
- added brief slow-motion effect when defeating a boss
- fixed issue preventing later bosses being impacted properly by player 'Super' attacks 
- fixed collision between falling burning beams and player
- fixed spelling error in Ricco's bio 
- removed purple flame effect being applied to boss characters due to size discrepancy 
- fixed issue where wolf wouldn't attack in sections of the gym stage
- fixed issue where heart icons appeared persistently in the gym stage when playing as Natasha
- fix to prevent repeated Clay reload animation which could occur when stage 1 boss appeared
- fix to timing of Clay reload animation / minor improvement to reload animation

Thanks!  Mike

notes.title: Fallen City Brawl Demo updated to v2.1!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Fallen City Brawl is in the final stages of development and I wanted to update the demo to share progress!  Its been some time since the last update, and there are lots of changes to the demo.  Here's the key ones:

[olist]
- all four characters are now playable; fight as Sgt.Clay, Natasha, Ricco or Iron Jackson
- local 2 player co-op!
- tutorial mode - a guided tutorial through basic attacks, specials, combos, and riot move
- all characters now have a unique special weapon alongside their special moves  - Sgt. Clay's Shotgun, Natasha's Wrench, Ricco's Handgun, and light up enemies with Iron Jackson's Molotov cocktail!
- updated powerful music and effects
- expanded move set - attack enemies on the ground and counter enemy attacks
- updates to Stage 1 with new visuals, music, enemy types, items and effects
- updated Riot (Super move) system and effects
- options and settings, including adjusting zoom and screen shake
- updates to the combo and scoring system
- lives and continues system in place
- minor bug fixes
[/olist]

I really hope you like the new update - please reply and let me know.  I hugely appreciate the support shown to the game, and your patience as I finish work to make this beat 'em up as hard-hitting and ferocious as it can be!

Mike

notes.title: Fallen City Brawl Demo Updated to V1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We've updated the Fallen City Brawl Demo to V1.2.  Here's a summary of the new features:

- an additional stage is now playable - Frozen Bamboo Forest
- added analogue stick control 
- the camera has been pulled back a little creating a larger play area
- more items to throw and break (Crates, wooden signs, motorbikes).  
- two new enemy types
- redrawn wolf 
- short time of invincibility after continue
- bug fixes and performance optimisation 

We hope you enjoy the update, let us know what you think!  Content remains work in progress, more to follow soon.  

Mike
